title: Enabling an Equitable Energy Transition Through Inclusive Research
Environmental justice and carbon pricing: can they be reconciled?
abstract: Carbon pricing has been criticized by environmental justice advocates on the grounds that it fails to reduce emissions significantly, fails to reduce the disproportionate impacts of hazardous co‐pollutants on people of color and low‐income communities, hits low‐income households harder than wealthier households, and commodifies nature. Designing carbon pricing policy to address these concerns can yield outcomes that are both more effective and more equitable.
abstract_zh: 碳定价遭到环境正义倡导者的批评，理由是：它无法显著减少排放；无法减轻有害的共污染物对有色人种和低收入社区的不成比例影响；对低收入家庭的打击比对富裕家庭更大；并且将自然商品化。如果在设计碳定价政策时能够回应这些关切，就可以得到既更有效、也更公平的结果。

title: Just decarbonization? Environmental inequality, air quality, and the clean energy transition
abstract: Environmental inequalities are often large and consequential, exacerbating vertical inequalities of income and class and horizontal inequalities along lines of race and ethnicity. Climate policies can widen these inequalities as well as mitigate them, depending on their design. Decarbonization of the US electricity sector illustrates these possibilities. A strategy narrowly focused on carbon reduction alone is likely in some regions to increase disparities in exposure to localized co-pollutants emitted by fossil fuel combustion and, in some cases, to increase exposure in absolute terms. Strategies that in addition explicitly mandate improvements in air quality, both overall and specifically for frontline communities, can couple decarbonization with remediation of environmental inequalities and broad-based gains in public health.
abstract_zh: 环境不平等往往规模很大且影响深远，它加剧了收入和阶层方面的纵向不平等，以及种族和族裔方面的横向不平等。气候政策既可能扩大这些不平等，也可能缓解这些不平等，这取决于其设计。美国电力部门的脱碳说明了这些可能性。一项仅狭隘地聚焦于减少碳排放的战略，在某些地区可能会扩大化石燃料燃烧所排放的局部共污染物的暴露差距，在某些情况下甚至会绝对地增加暴露水平。而那些还明确要求改善空气质量（包括总体空气质量，以及尤其是一线社区的空气质量）的战略，则可以将脱碳与环境不平等的补救结合起来，并带来广泛的公共健康收益。

title: Greenhouse Suppliers 100: A Ranking of Corporate Producers of Greenhouse Gas Precursors in the USA
abstract: This paper presents the first comprehensive database of corporate suppliers of fossil fuels and greenhouse gas supply stocks in the U.S. economy. The database is a publicly available resource that adds value to existing information sources in two ways. First, we combine several high-quality public data sources, including the US Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Greenhouse Gas Reporting Program (GHGRP), which reports on most products that would result in GHG emissions if those products were released, combusted, or oxidized, with the notable exception of coal, and data on coal from the US Energy Information Administration and the US Mine Safety and Health Administration. In this paper, we discuss the importance of coal as a GHG source and describe its exclusion from coverage by the GHGRP. Second, we aggregate facility-level data (on individual mines, wellheads, refineries, pipelines, and import facilities) to the corporate level, with the corporate final parent as the unit of analysis. While the data collection of the EPA focuses on individual facilities as the reporting units, the analysis of corporate ownership shifts attention to control and responsibility. Here we use these data to explore the corporate concentration of GHG activity, and we compare the degree of concentration between GHG supply and emissions, and between the facility level and the corporate level. Finally, we discuss current and potential applications and possible extensions, such as the development of environmental-justice metrics for fossil-fuel suppliers.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了美国经济中化石燃料和温室气体供应存量企业供应商的首个综合数据库。该数据库是一项公开可用的资源，通过两种方式增加了现有信息来源的价值。第一，我们整合了多个高质量的公共数据来源，包括美国环境保护署（EPA）温室气体报告计划（GHGRP）的数据——该计划报告了大多数如果被释放、燃烧或氧化就会产生温室气体排放的产品，但煤炭除外——同时结合了美国能源信息署和美国矿山安全与健康管理局的煤炭数据。本文讨论了煤炭作为温室气体来源的重要性，并说明其被温室气体报告计划排除在外的原因。第二，我们将设施层面的数据（涉及单个矿山、井口、炼油厂、管道和进口设施）汇总到企业层面，并以企业最终母公司作为分析单位。尽管环保署的数据收集以单个设施作为报告单位，但企业所有权的分析则将关注点转向控制权和责任。在此，我们利用这些数据考察温室气体活动的企业集中度，并比较温室气体供应与排放之间、设施层面与企业层面之间的集中程度差异。最后，我们讨论了当前和潜在的应用及可能的扩展，例如为化石燃料供应商开发环境正义指标。

title: Initially High Correlation between Air Pollution and COVID-19 Mortality Declined to Zero as the Pandemic Progressed: There Is No Evidence for a Causal Link between Air Pollution and COVID-19 Vulnerability
venue: International Journal of Environmental Research and Public Health
abstract: Wu et al. found a strong positive association between cumulative daily county-level COVID-19 mortality and long-term average PM2.5 concentrations for data up until September 2020. We replicated the results of Wu et al. and extended the analysis up until May 2022. The association between PM2.5 concentration and cumulative COVID-19 mortality fell sharply after September 2020. Using the data available from Wu et al.’s “updated_data” branch up until May 2022, we found that the effect of a 1 μg/m3 increase in PM2.5 was associated with only a +0.603% mortality difference. The 95% CI of this difference was between −0.560% and +1.78%, narrow bounds that include zero, with the upper bound far below the Wu et al. estimate. Short-term trends in the initial spread of COVID-19, not a long-term epidemiologic association, caused an early correlation between air pollution and COVID-19 mortality.
abstract_zh: Wu等人发现，在截至2020年9月的数据中，县级累计每日COVID-19死亡人数与长期平均PM2.5浓度之间存在强烈的正相关关系。我们复现了Wu等人的结果，并将分析延伸至2022年5月。2020年9月之后，PM2.5浓度与累计COVID-19死亡人数之间的关联急剧下降。利用Wu等人“updated_data”分支中截至2022年5月的可用数据，我们发现PM2.5浓度每增加1 μg/m³，仅与死亡率差异+0.603%相关。该差异的95%置信区间为−0.560%至+1.78%，这是一个包含零的较窄区间，且其上界远低于Wu等人的估计。早期COVID-19传播的短期趋势，而非长期的流行病学关联，导致了空气污染与COVID-19死亡之间的早期相关性。

Racial disparities in pollution exposure and employment at US industrial facilities
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract: Debate about regulation of industrial polluters often concerns a presumed trade-off between negative pollution impacts and positive employment opportunities. These arguments are especially sensitive among communities of racial/ethnic minorities, who disproportionately suffer exposure to pollution and lack access to high-quality employment. We combine US Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) data on toxics exposure with Equal Employment Opportunity Commission (EEOC) data on employment to examine how the racial/ethnic distribution of industrial employment corresponds to the distribution of exposure to air toxics emitted by the same facilities. The share of pollution risk accruing to minority groups generally exceeds their share of employment and greatly exceeds their share of higher paying jobs. In aggregate, we find no evidence that facilities that create higher pollution risk for surrounding communities provide more jobs.
abstract_zh: 关于工业污染者监管的争论，常常涉及负面污染影响与积极就业机会之间假定的权衡。这些争论在少数族裔社区中尤为敏感，因为这些社区不成比例地遭受污染暴露，并且难以获得高质量的就业机会。我们将美国环保署（EPA）的有毒物质暴露数据与美国平等就业机会委员会（EEOC）的就业数据相结合，考察工业就业的种族/族裔分布与同一设施所排放空气毒物的暴露分布之间的对应关系。少数群体所承担的污染风险份额，通常超过其在就业中的份额，并大大超过其在高薪工作中的份额。总体而言，我们没有发现证据表明，对周边社区造成更高污染风险的设施会提供更多就业岗位。

Is Environmental Justice Good for White Folks?
abstract:
The study examines spatial variation in exposure to toxic air pollution from industrial facilities in urban areas of the United States in relation to the local distribution of the pollution burden.
We conducted between‐ and within‐city analysis of geographic microdata from the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency's Risk‐Screening Environmental Indicators project and data from the 2000 U.S. Census.
Average exposure in an urban area is positively correlated with the extent of racial and ethnic disparity in the distribution of the exposure burden. Average exposures also tend to be higher for all population subgroups, including whites, in urban areas with higher minority pollution‐exposure discrepancies.
The correlations could arise from causal linkages in either or both directions: the ability to displace pollution onto minorities may lower the effective cost of pollution for industrial firms; and higher average pollution burdens may induce whites to invest more political capital in efforts to influence firms’ siting decisions. The analysis suggests that improvement in environmental justice could benefit not only minorities but also whites.
abstract_zh:
本研究考察了美国城市地区工业设施有毒空气污染暴露的空间差异，及其与当地污染负担分布之间的关系。
我们利用美国环境保护署风险筛选环境指标（Risk-Screening Environmental Indicators）项目的地理微观数据，以及2000年美国人口普查数据，开展了城市之间和城市内部的分析。
城市地区的平均暴露水平与暴露负担的种族和族裔差异程度呈正相关。在种族和族裔少数群体的污染暴露差异较大的城市地区，包括白人在内的所有人口亚群体的平均暴露水平也往往更高。
这些相关性可能源于一个或两个方向的因果联系：将污染转嫁给少数群体的能力，可能降低了工业企业污染的有效成本；而较高的平均污染负担，可能促使白人投入更多政治资本，以影响企业的选址决策。该分析表明，改善环境正义不仅会使少数群体受益，也可能使白人受益。

Measuring Corporate Environmental Justice Performance
venue: Corporate Social Responsibility and Environmental Management
abstract: Measures of corporate environmental justice performance can be a valuable tool in efforts to promote corporate social responsibility and to document systematic patterns of environmental injustice. This paper develops such a measure based on the extent to which toxic air emissions from industrial facilities disproportionately impact racial and ethnic minorities and those on low incomes. Applying the measure to 100 major corporate air polluters in the United States, we find wide variation in the extent of disproportional exposures. In 54 cases, minorities, who represent 31.8% of the US population, bear excess burden; in 15 of these cases, the minority share exceeds half of the total human health impacts from the firm's industrial air pollution. In 66 cases, poor people, who represent 12.8% of the US population, bear excess burden. Copyright © 2010 John Wiley & Sons, Ltd and ERP Environment.
abstract_zh: 企业环境正义绩效的度量，可以成为推动企业社会责任、记录环境不公正系统性模式的重要工具。本文基于工业设施排放的有毒空气污染在多大程度上不成比例地影响少数种族和族裔群体及低收入人群，构建了这样一种度量指标。将该指标应用于美国100家主要企业空气污染者，我们发现不成比例暴露的程度差异很大。在54个案例中，占美国人口31.8%的少数族裔承担了超额负担；其中15个案例中，少数族裔的比例超过了该企业工业空气污染所造成人体健康总影响的一半。在66个案例中，占美国人口12.8%的贫困人口承担了超额负担。版权所有©2010 John Wiley & Sons, Ltd and ERP Environment。
